purpose: Teach: 書面/代理人/不調/派閥/期末/行き先/続行/後押し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究計画、本気で、絶対、書面、絶対、で、絶対、提出しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need that research plan in writing. Submit it properly. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Direct and measured, no softening. Weight on each instruction. Calm authority—not angry, but leaving no room for misunderstanding. A mentor making a clear ask.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会、本気で、絶対、代理人、絶対、として、絶対、出席、絶対、することになりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed I'll be attending the conference as your representative. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful and genuine. Slight breathiness on the confirmation—he's earned this trust and knows it. Warm gratitude underneath the formality, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、体調、本気で、絶対、不調、絶対、なら、絶対、お休みしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — if you're not feeling well, take the time off. Don't push through it.
lines.style: Softer attack than before. This is gentler—the mentor checking in on the person, not just the student. A beat of genuine concern underneath the practicality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学内、本気で、絶対、派閥、絶対、には、絶対、関わらないようにしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm staying out of the campus politics. Thank you for looking out for me.
lines.style: Quiet understanding. He's heard the warning and is acknowledging it seriously. Humble but not self-deprecating—the gratitude is for guidance, not apology.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、期末、本気で、絶対、試験、絶対、しっかり、絶対、頑張れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — give your best effort on the end-of-term exams. I expect that from you.
lines.style: Steady encouragement with an undertone of confidence in him. Not harsh—this is belief phrased as an ask. A mentor who knows what his student can do.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。フィールド調査、本気で、絶対、行き先、絶対、決定いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've settled on the location for my fieldwork. I'm grateful for your support through this.
lines.style: Clear and composed. Pride in the progress without bragging. The gratitude is specific—not reflexive politeness, but genuine recognition of guidance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、続行、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — keep going with the research. You're on the right track.
lines.style: Warmth breaking through the formality slightly. This is affirmation—not lavish, but genuine. Steady, measured delivery. The words are spare but they land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授、本気で、絶対、後押し、絶対、感謝しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm truly grateful for your support, Professor. Thank you.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity on the close. This is where he lets the weight of his appreciation show without overstating it. A beat longer on the final thanks, like something settled.
